preregistration: COMMITTED BEFORE EXAMINING ANY OF THE 620001/630001 NATIVE PHYSX TEST OUTCOMES
question: Can task-blind observable robust-controller target authority margin decide whether to query privately at t=4, while preserving task success with fewer private reads than fixed t=4 and against task-label-conditioned strong baseline?
prior_evidence_only: Previous source-frozen 520001-520032/530001-530032 result: task-only route 58/64 with 56 reads, fixed 58/64 with 64; this is DEVELOPMENT DATA, never this new outcome.

fixed_policies.proactive_t4: For the 4-candidate controller target belief at zero-index step 4 (after two held-arm targets), compute a same-frozen-model certified common action before ever reading private target; if it is authorized but the larger normalized certified position/rotation error >=0.75, read once now, else continue with the same bounded action and query on its first future refusal. If the t4 certificate already refuses, query. Max one read per episode. Never use label or task name to choose. The source policy's achieved EE position is a public observation, not private controller target memory.
fixed_policies.fixed_t4: Always make one privileged controller-target read at step 4 if alive, even when robust command feasible
fixed_policies.reactive: Query only when a common bounded action refuses
fixed_policies.task_gated: Precommitted opponent: PullCube use reactive, StackCube use fixed-t4; strong known-task specialized baseline
fixed_policies.zero: Bounded action without any private query
fixed_policies.optimistic: Assume both unknown arm ACKs were received

metric_definitions.fault_truth: two actual zero/hold arm action replacements in ManiSkill PhysX t=2 and t=3; not actual packet loss
